description: Pay-per-call: 25 free/day then $0.001 USDC via x402. Token & cost calculator: estimate tokens for a text (or pass input_tokens/output_tokens) and price it across several models using provider list prices (LiteLLM price table, MIT). Params: models (comma list of model ids like gpt-4o-mini, claude-sonnet-4-5, gemini/gemini-2.5-flash or search words, max 15), text or input_tokens, output_tokens, calls. Calling this tool returns the HTTP request and x402 payment requirements (or use the free quota).
name: llm_cost
